title: In repos/metric-collector-vessel/src/config.ts the PORT default is 8280, which collides with light-dispatch-vessel defau
description: In repos/metric-collector-vessel/src/config.ts the PORT default is 8280, which collides with light-dispatch-vessel default of 8280. The metric-collector unit file sets PORT=8300. Change the in-code default to 8300 so the unit override is redundant rather than load-bearing.
goal_text: In repos/metric-collector-vessel/src/config.ts the PORT default is 8280, which collides with light-dispatch-vessel default of 8280. The metric-collector unit file sets PORT=8300. Change the in-code default to 8300 so the unit override is redundant rather than load-bearing.
